notes:
Ids 803 (user), 907 (location) and 960 (membership) are the next in each table's sequence on the seed; the task creates one row in each of those tables.
'Location Created and Linked' tests only the location row although its name says linked; the link (user 803 location_id = 907) is a separate requirement that no benchmark check tests.
'Offboarding Complete' reads the active value rather than a count; its requirement restates it as a count of the deactivated row.
The request names a Customer Service team, but no group of that name exists; group 6 follows from the policy's rule that an assignee must belong to the case's assignment group.
The acting user, Jose Roberson (user 32), is an administrator whose account is inactive in the seed; the policy gives administrators user, location and membership changes and states no rule that bars an inactive acting user, so the file assumes the request is carried out.
The order the request sets (deactivate only after the cases are transferred) cannot be seen in the final state and is not tested. Susan's phone is not given and is not tested.
Requirement texts and assumptions otherwise differ between the passes in wording only.
